notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.content: Christmas update gives more levels with winter climate, costumes and special level! For more info visit website.

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content: Halloween update - you can play 3 extra levels with new costumes. For more informations visit website.

notes.title: HOTFIX v1.21
notes.content:
1. Added new panels in level constructor
2. Fixed desktop logo
3. Game is now 50% more optimized
4. Some changes on website and store page

notes.title: Summer Update!
notes.content: Now you can play 3 more levels with new costumes. Also new achievement has been added. For more informations visit website.

notes.title: Easter Update
notes.content: With easter update to game has been added new chapter X (4). There are levels related to year-round events and rules of gameplay are different. Also new costume is available in each and new achievement has been added. For more informations visit website.
